behavior.walls: Footprint-corner visibility and partial-cover thresholds use native sight collision.
behavior.coverRegions: A sight-height line entering, leaving or crossing any enabled cover Region grants its configured cover, including legacy occupants configurations.
behavior.firingRadius: A source within the configured radius ignores that Region against a target outside the radius; incoming attacks and two creatures sharing the cover use ordinary cover.
behavior.visibility: Cover Regions change defense and Hide eligibility but do not block sight; Foundry walls own visibility blocking.

tests.regression: Legacy occupant Region ray crossing, outgoing firing bypass, shared-cover defense, sight-wall corner cover, manual roll defense and AI environment scoring.
